opticalSight.name: BM 3-12X40
opticalSight.description: The 3-12x magnification optical sight manufactured by BM Corporation allows T-Dolls to hit the enemy's vital points more easily. Can be equipped by all except HG.

opticalSight.name: LRA 2-12x50
opticalSight.description: A new model of optical sight developed by LRA Corporation. It provides a high magnification and a wide field of view. Can be equipped by all except HG.

opticalSight.name: PSO-1
opticalSight.description: Possessing a compact and reliable design, the military-grade optical sight incorporates specialized reticle subtensions, allowing for ease of use on the battlefield. Can be equipped by all except HG.

opticalSight.name: VFL 6-24X56
opticalSight.description: An excellent scope specially built for long-distance sniping, it is made from the best materials and optical components, ensuring outstanding and reliable performance. Can be equipped by all except HG.

opticalSight.name: 16Lab 6-24X56
opticalSight.description: 16Lab's optical sight of choice. Slap 16Lab's logo on a limited edition and you can sell it for ten times the price. Awesome, huh?

holographicSight.name: EOT 506
holographicSight.description: The Type 506 Holographic Sight manufactured by EOT Corporation. It looks pretty cool. Can be equipped by all except HG.

holographicSight.name: EOT 512
holographicSight.description: The Type 512 Holographic Sight manufactured by EOT Corporation. It looks pretty cool. Can be equipped by all except HG.

holographicSight.name: EOT 516
holographicSight.description: The Type 516 Holographic Sight manufactured by EOT Corporation. It looks very cool. Can be equipped by all except HG.

holographicSight.name: EOT 518
holographicSight.description: The Type 518 Holographic Sight manufactured by EOT Corporation. It looks super cool. Can be equipped by all except HG.

redDotSight.name: AMP COMPM2
redDotSight.description: The COMPML Red Dot Sight manufactured by AMP Corporation. Its only merit is its sturdiness. Can be equipped by all except HG.

redDotSight.name: AMP COMPM4
redDotSight.description: The COMPML Red Dot Sight manufactured by AMP Corporation. Its design has been enhanced, increasing its sturdiness even more. Can be equipped by all except HG.

redDotSight.name: COG M150
redDotSight.description: The greatest advantage of COG Corporation's advanced red dot sight is that it does not require batteries to assist in aiming in any situation. Can be equipped by all except HG.

redDotSight.name: ITI MARS
redDotSight.description: An integrated red dot sight developed by ITI Corporation, it incorporates multiple functions without affecting shooting performance and is equipped with an anti-reflection system. Can be equipped by all except HG.

redDotSight.name: 16Lab MARS
redDotSight.description: A red dot sight calibrated by 16Lab. Comes in a limited edition serial number with an optional tan paint job. Can be equipped by all except HG.

nightBattleEquipment.name: PEQ-2
nightBattleEquipment.description: An early model ATPIAL infrared designator issued by IOP Corporation for their T-Dolls. Now T-Dolls can hit things at night! Can only be equipped by SMGs, HGs, and ARs.

nightBattleEquipment.name: PEQ-5
nightBattleEquipment.description: The standard model ATPIAL infrared designator issued by IOP Corporation for their T-Dolls. Much of the early model's deficiencies had been fixed in this model, but its battery still runs out very quickly. Can only be equipped by SMGs, HGs, and ARs.

nightBattleEquipment.name: PEQ-15
nightBattleEquipment.description: An improved model of the ATPIAL infrared designator issued by IOP Corporation for their T-Dolls, it effectively increases the T-Dolls' combat efficiency during nighttime. Can only be equipped by SMGs, HGs, and ARs.

nightBattleEquipment.name: PEQ-16A
nightBattleEquipment.description: A custom model of the ATPIAL infrared designator issued by IOP Corporation for their T-Dolls, it is able to fulfill all their operational needs when battling at night. Can only be equipped by SMGs, HGs, and ARs.

nightBattleEquipment.name: 16Lab Infrared Designator
nightBattleEquipment.description: An infrared designator system specially developed by 16Lab. Much of its superfluous functions and weight have been removed, leaving behind a truly practical night battle equipment that allows T-Dolls to perform to their fullest potential. Can only be equipped by SMGs, HGs, and ARs.

nightBattleEquipment.name: S.F. Modified Tactical Light
nightBattleEquipment.description: A standard issue tactical light developed by Sangvis Ferri Industries. With IOP's modifications, it can now be controlled directly by a T-Doll's processor, which greatly enhances the Doll's combat capability in night battles. It can be equipped on all firearms except Rifles and Machine Guns.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: M61 Armor-Piercing Ammo
armorPiercingAmmo.description: The Type M61 armor-piercing ammunition manufactured by IOP Corporation possesses a standard steel-core armor piercing bullet design, aimed at penetrating enemy armor and causing effective damage. Can be equipped by RFs and MGs.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: M993 Armor-Piercing Ammo
armorPiercingAmmo.description: The Type M993 armor-piercing ammunition manufactured by IOP Corporation was developed to counter enemies possessing thicker armor by using a tungsten alloy material, aimed at penetrating enemy armor and causing effective damage. Can be equipped by RFs and MGs.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: Mk169 Armor-Piercing Ammo
armorPiercingAmmo.description: The Type Mk169 armor-piercing ammunition developed by IOP in conjunction with the FCA Research Center has a specially made tungsten alloy core designed to be able to penetrate any enemy's armor. Can be equipped by RFs and MGs.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: Mk211 High-Explosive Armor-Piercing Ammo
armorPiercingAmmo.description: The Type Mk211 high-explosive armor-piercing ammunition developed by IOP in conjunction with the FCA Research Center uses a combination of a tungsten alloy bullet and a high-explosive design to further improve its lethality. Can be equipped by RFs and MGs.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: 16Lab Sub-Caliber Armor-Piercing Ammo
armorPiercingAmmo.description: A depleted uranium high-explosive armor-piercing ammunition recently developed by 16Lab, it is capable of penetrating any type of armor and causing heavy damage. Can be equipped by RFs and MGs.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: M33 Sniper Rounds
armorPiercingAmmo.description: These rounds are specially-designed for long-range shooting and sacrifice a certain degree of armor-penetration capability for a longer and flatter trajectory. Can be used by rifles and machine guns.

armorPiercingAmmo.name: M1022 Sniper Rounds
armorPiercingAmmo.description: A brand new kind of long-range sniping ammunition. Features improved shooting ballistics over ordinary sniper rounds. Can be used by rifles and machine guns.

highVelocityAmmo.name: FMJ High-Velocity Ammo
highVelocityAmmo.description: The FCA Research Center's assault rifle-specific FMJ high-velocity ammunition effectively boosts the output of assault rifles through high quality, high pressure gunpowder. They are issued with MP Group's reliable and lightweight magazines.

highVelocityAmmo.name: JSP High-Velocity Ammo
highVelocityAmmo.description: The FCA Research Center's assault rifle-specific JSP high-velocity ammunition uses an experimental bullet design to further increase the output of assault rifles. They are issued with MP Group's reliable and lightweight magazines.

highVelocityAmmo.name: JHP High-Velocity Ammo
highVelocityAmmo.description: The FCA Research Center's assault rifle-specific JHP high-velocity ammunition was developed with the experience gained from previous bullet designs and experimentations, greatly increasing its damaging capabilities. They are issued with MP Group's reliable and lightweight magazines.

highVelocityAmmo.name: APCR High-Velocity Ammo
highVelocityAmmo.description: The FCA Research Center's experimental APCR high-velocity ammunition integrates the idea of armor-piercing ammunition and uses a different design methodology to increase its lethality. They are issued with MP Group's reliable and lightweight magazines.

highVelocityAmmo.name: 16Lab High-Velocity Ammo
highVelocityAmmo.description: 16Lab's special high-velocity ammo rivals that of the top line match grade ammunition in terms of precision and accuracy. You'd better save these babies for a special occasion. They are issued with MP Group's reliable and lightweight magazines.

exoskeleton.name: IOP T1 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type T1 Exoskeleton is an early model developed by IOP Corporation, aimed at increasing the agility of T-Dolls through the exoskeleton system. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP T2 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type T2 Exoskeleton is the standard model manufactured by IOP Corporation with improved performance and flexibility. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP T3 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type T3 Exoskeleton is an enhanced model developed by IOP Corporation. Through improvements in technology, it has greater flexibility while at the same time detracting less from the shooting ability of the user. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP T4 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type T4 Exoskeleton is a custom model developed by IOP Corporation, specially developed based on the T-Dolls' characteristics so as to maximize their mobility and while minimizing the impact on their shooting ability. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP X1 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type X1 Exoskeleton is an early model developed by IOP Corporation, aimed at increasing the agility of T-Dolls through the exoskeleton system. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP X2 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type X2 Exoskeleton is the standard model manufactured by IOP Corporation with improved performance and flexibility. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP X3 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type X3 Exoskeleton is an enhanced model developed by IOP Corporation. Through improvements in technology, it has greater flexibility while at the same time detracting less from the shooting ability of the user. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: IOP X4 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: The Type X4 Exoskeleton is a custom model crafted by IOP Corporation, specially developed based on the T-Dolls' characteristics so as to maximize their mobility and while minimizing the impact on their shooting ability. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

exoskeleton.name: 16Lab T4 Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.description: 16Lab's custom-made high-performance exoskeleton features a titanium alloy frame that is difficult to fabricate but is lightweight and strong. Can be equipped by HGs, SMGs, and most ARs.

armorPlate.name: Type 1 Armor Plate
armorPlate.description: The protective grade Type I Fiber Plate provided by IOP Corporation helps to reduce the damage taken from being shot, increasing T-Dolls' survivability on the battlefield.

armorPlate.name: Type 2 Armor Plate
armorPlate.description: The protective grade Type II Composite Plate provided by IOP Corporation helps to greatly reduce the damage taken from being shot, greatly enhancing T-Dolls' survivability on the battlefield.

armorPlate.name: Type 3 Armor Plate
armorPlate.description: The protective grade Type III Kevlar Plate provided by IOP Corporation can resist high-caliber ammunition, massively enhancing T-Dolls' survivability on the battlefield.

armorPlate.name: 16Lab Armor Plate
armorPlate.description: A composite ceramic and kevlar armor plate developed by 16Lab. It possesses a strong bullet-resistant ability and is extremely lightweight. The ideal choice for an elite.

specialMagazine.name: National Match-Grade Armor-Piercing Ammo
specialMagazine.description: A legacy item of the early 20th century, the National Match-Grade Armor-Piercing Ammunition was specially made for The National Springfield Rifle Match. Can only be equipped by Springfield.

specialMagazine.name: .300BLK High-Velocity Ammo
specialMagazine.description: The .300 Blackout high-velocity ammunition was specially developed by 16Lab and is recommended for use with a suppressor. Can only be equipped by ST AR-15.

specialMagazine.name: XM261 ACP
specialMagazine.description: The experimental ammunition that was once developed for CQC in the brutal tunnels of the War is essentially a shotgun shell that can be fired with a .45 caliber pistol. Can only be equipped by M1911.

specialMagazine.name: SP6 Subsonic Ammo
specialMagazine.description: Subsonic ammunition developed for use with a suppressor. Its steel tip makes it highly versatile. Can only be equipped by AS Val.

specialMagazine.name: 7.92 KURZ
specialMagazine.description: This 7.9mm ammunition developed for StG44 is one of the world's first intermediate cartridges. The use of steel casing due to a lack of brass gives it a stylish and unique look. Can only be equipped by StG44.

specialMagazine.name: Adelhyde
specialMagazine.description: The sweet component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialMagazine.name: Bronson Extract
specialMagazine.description: The bitter component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialMagazine.name: Karmotrine
specialMagazine.description: The alcoholic component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialMagazine.name: MIRD Class-5 Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Dorothy made private modifications to her fingers, allowing them to fire powerful ammunition.

specialMagazine.name: 20GA Buckshot
specialMagazine.description: This bright yellow shell contains twenty pellets. It boasts top muzzle velocity and excellent spread pattern, greatly increasing the lethality of KS23.

specialMagazine.name: 20mm HEI
specialMagazine.description: What is more terrifying than a 20mm round flying towards you at high speed? The answer is a 20mm High-Explosive Incendiary. Before you even hear the gunshot, the wall in front of you, you, the wall behind you, and your neighbor behind the wall behind you...are all gone.

specialMagazine.name: 9x39mm SPP
specialMagazine.description: The new 9x39mm round comes with better armor penetration than other bullets of the same caliber. The harmless-looking blue tip masks an astonishingly destructive force that mustn't be taken lightly.

specialMagazine.name: FRAG-12 High Explosive Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These are high-explosive rounds designed for 12-gauge shotguns and quickly became a major selling point for the AA-12 on the market. With the combination of the explosive rounds' effect and the AA-12's full automatic shooting, art is a blast!

specialMagazine.name: 7N31
specialMagazine.description: They have higher penetration than regular 9x19mm Parabellum rounds. GSh-18 bought a lot of 7N31 rounds in order to deal with the ever-growing number of armored units.

specialMagazine.name: 12.7mm 1SL
specialMagazine.description: These were originally special rounds used by attack helicopters, with a second bullet loaded into the cartridge to improve accuracy against ground targets. KSVK pleaded with I.O.P. to modify these rounds for normal use with her weapon, which would allow her to provide excellent suppressive fire during battles.

specialMagazine.name: RIP380ACP
specialMagazine.description: Spinning explosion! These hollow-point rounds are vicious in both appearance and effect, and their expanding tips can do extreme damage to soft targets. Truly a round worthy of the name "R.I.P."

specialMagazine.name: S&B762
specialMagazine.description: 85-grain full metal jacket bullets allow for greater penetration and have become Type 79's new favorite.

specialMagazine.name: Bayonet
specialMagazine.description: When guns cannot be used, one fights with knives, fists, and teeth. Whatever it takes to win.

specialMagazine.name: .357 Jacketed Hollow Point Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These 180-grain .357 hollow point rounds feature copper jackets to minimize barrel fouling, while also increasing wound channel size.

specialMagazine.name: .45 Hollow Point Ammo (Incendiary)
specialMagazine.description: Modified from the regular hollow point ammo. It has a chance of setting enemies on fire, thus dealing more damage.

specialMagazine.name: 556 High-Velocity Ammo (Explosive)
specialMagazine.description: Modified from regular 5.56mm high-velocity rounds. They explode upon hitting an enemy, thus dealing more damage. Supposedly, they also have the ability to draw targets' attention.

specialMagazine.name: 12-gauge Flechette Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These special flechette rounds were used in past wars. Each shell contains 20 miniature flechettes. Supposedly, they were used to take out enemies in jungles.

specialMagazine.name: Arisaka AP Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These Arisaka 7.7mm rounds are painted with different colors on their tips to denote different ammunition types. Among them, black tips indicate that the rounds in question were designed to pierce armor.

specialMagazine.name: Custom Tracer Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These tracer rounds were designed for Type 56R, combining the ability to highlight enemy targets with the ability to set them on fire. Truly killing two birds with one stone.

specialMagazine.name: Custom API Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These API rounds were designed to overcome armor. Type 80 uses vast quantities of these special rounds.

specialMagazine.name: 20-gauge Custom Slug Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These special 20-gauge slug rounds combine with Defender's 8-round volley fire ability to inflict a devastating blow on the enemy.

specialMagazine.name: Magnetic Accelerated Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A new special ammo that 16LAB has specially designed for Type 88's acceleration coil, which greatly boosts the muzzle velocity.

specialMagazine.name: 9x18mm FTX
specialMagazine.description: A new model of 9x18mm hollow point bullets that are Makarov's favorite. The red tip improves the consistency of fragmentation, making the rounds more lethal.

specialMagazine.name: Mk4 SLAP
specialMagazine.description: 5.56mm armor-piercing discarding sabot projectiles specially developed for Gr MG4 by IOP. Due to its intricate construction, the production cost for each single round is very high.

specialMagazine.name: M118LR
specialMagazine.description: XM3's go-to military sniper rounds. They have remarkable precision and lethality in long-range battles.

specialMagazine.name: 7N14
specialMagazine.description: 7.62mm armor-piercing rounds developed for the Sniper Rifle, System of Dragunov, featuring improved lethality against armored units.

specialMagazine.name: 7.92mm Anti-Tank Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A special caliber round used in an old world war that was designed for PzB39. After modification by IOP, it is can now do an impressive amount of damage to contemporary armored targets.

specialMagazine.name: B32 Armor-Piercing Rounds
specialMagazine.description: B32 API rounds that IOP redesigned for Gepard M1. They deal spectacular damage to armored targets.

specialMagazine.name: SP81
specialMagazine.description: A flare gun used in past wars. One of MP-443's favorite items.

specialMagazine.name: DBP10 (Type 03)
specialMagazine.description: DBP19 rounds that IOP recalibrated specially for Type 03. There is a significant improvement in muzzle velocity compared to the regular version.

specialMagazine.name: .357 Wadcutter Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These 200-grain wadcutter rounds have been specially tuned for Python. Their greater powder load and heavier heads lead to extraordinary destructive power.

specialMagazine.name: Tokarev Jacketed Hollowpoint Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These Tokarev jacketed hollowpoint rounds were custom-made for PPSh-41 and greatly increase her weapon's stopping power.

specialMagazine.name: Wolf 9mm Hollowpoint Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These 9mm rounds have been specially adjusted for T77 by the Wolf company. They greatly reduce the failure rate and experienced recoil.

specialMagazine.name: 57-N-323S
specialMagazine.description: An early kind of steel-core round that is light and easy to carry. After modification for SVT-38 by IOP, it has become specialized ammunition for her.

specialMagazine.name: Leuchtpistole 34
specialMagazine.description: A flare gun which has seen a lot of action in past wars. A favorite of PPK's due to its small and portable size.

specialMagazine.name: M43 Flare Pistol
specialMagazine.description: A flare gun which has seen a lot of action in past wars. A favorite of Suomi's, this weapon can fire a larger variety of signal flares thanks to IOP's modifications.

specialMagazine.name: Type 92 Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: A signal flare for Type 92's exclusive use. It is a replica of a famous signal flare modified by IOP for increased reliability.

specialMagazine.name: L42 Experimental Armor-Piercing Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A type of special armor-piercing rounds that IOP developed solely for Lee-Enfield. By incorporating APDS technology, these rounds are now vastly more destructive.

specialMagazine.name: MK318 Mod X
specialMagazine.description: A brand new cartridge that IOP developed solely for SCAR-L based on the MK318 military cartridge. It has excellent penetration and lethality.

specialMagazine.name: M948 Mod X
specialMagazine.description: A brand new APDS cartridge that IOP developed solely for SCAR-H based on the M949 military cartridge. It has drastically improved accuracy and lethality compared to the standard M948 rounds.

specialMagazine.name: PSP Special Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Special underwater ammunition designed specially for ADS. With IOP's modification, it is just as effective in non-aquatic environments.

specialMagazine.name: 8mm Mauser Special Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A 8mm Mauser cartridge that IOP developed solely for ZB-26. The cartridge adopts the same round tip as the Patrone 88. Thanks to IOP's technology, it is even more lethal than contemporary rounds.

specialMagazine.name: 6.5x50mm Modified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: 6.5x50mm rounds modified by IOP for Type 81R's exclusive use. They are both highly lethal and dependable.

specialMagazine.name: Dried Shredded Squid
specialMagazine.description: Dried Shredded Squid — the light of Tae Yamada's life and the fuel of her desire. No one can take her dried shredded squid from her and live to tell the tale. No one!

specialMagazine.name: Star Hair Clip
specialMagazine.description: This pretty hair clip is an important component to Lily Hoshikawa. A Lily Hoshikawa without her hair clip is incomplete!

specialMagazine.name: Type 11 Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: An exclusive signal flare that IOP redesigned from its Type 10 predecessor for 100 Shiki. It can exchange data directly with 100 Shiki's neural cloud.

specialMagazine.name: 7BT1
specialMagazine.description: A custom BT armor-piercing tracer sniper round featuring IOP's modification. It can cause considerable damage even to targets with armor protection.

specialMagazine.name: .223 Competition Cartridge
specialMagazine.description: A .223 competition cartridge that IOP developed exclusively for Gr SL8. The exquisite craftsmanship has greatly improved its performance.

specialMagazine.name: M2 Custom Armor-Piercing Round
specialMagazine.description: Modified from the M2 armor-piercing round, this iteration features greatly enhanced muzzle velocity and ballistic performance.

specialMagazine.name: 7.62 P80 Armor-Piercing Round
specialMagazine.description: 7.62x51mm armor-piercing round that IOP developed independently for UKM-2000. It is fully optimized for UKM-2000's barrel, greatly improving the muzzle velocity.

specialMagazine.name: Type 57 Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: A flare gun that Stechkin always carries on her person. With IOP's modification, Stechkin can now better assist her echelon in combat with it.

specialMagazine.name: Type 64 Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: Type 64's favorite flare gun. With IOP's modification, Type 64 can command and contact her echelon better.

specialMagazine.name: Tokarev Pistol Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A type of ammunition used on battlefields in the old world. It also happens to be Tokarev's preferred type.

specialMagazine.name: Custom 10mm Auto Rounds
specialMagazine.description: 10mm auto rounds with shortened cartridge cases, which greatly reduce the recoil impact.

specialMagazine.name: M856 Tracer Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Custom tracer rounds made specially for 416 that can aid in battles by making shot calibrations, lighting up targets, and sending signals.

specialMagazine.name: .45UMP Hollow-Point Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A new type of hollow-point rounds custom made for UMP45 with greatly reduced sonic boom.

specialMagazine.name: 9mm UMP Hollow-Point Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A new type of hollow-point rounds custom made for UMP9 with improved lethality.

specialMagazine.name: 12.7mm Modified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The modification made to the regular 12.7mm cartridge makes it even more lethal than the .50 BMG and a better fit for 6P62.

specialMagazine.name: MAS Custom Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The upgraded 7.5Ã—54 mm cartridge makes use of less corrosive gunpowder and also packs a more powerful punch.

specialMagazine.name: .30-64 Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The newly rolled out rifle cartridge with a caliber of 0.30 inches features a heavier bullet and adjustment to the case length, which greatly enhance its penetration.

specialMagazine.name: M43 Modified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Ordinary 7.62x39mm caliber steel-core ammo that IOP modified and upgraded for Type 56-1. Featuring the latest processing technology, the bullets' penetration has been greatly enhanced.

specialMagazine.name: Mk948SLAP
specialMagazine.description: The 7.62mm caliber armor-piercing discarding sabot rounds developed by IOP specifically for MG3 features noticeable improvement in accuracy.

specialMagazine.name: DIY Smart Grenade
specialMagazine.description: The 20mm grenade that K11 modified herself has eradicated its initial problems with irregular detonation delays and aiming inaccuracies. It is also significantly more lethal against targets.

specialMagazine.name: 18.4mm Baton Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Type 97S' most commonly-used ammo when she is on duty. They are perfect for dispersing all kinds of rioters and evildoers.

specialMagazine.name: GP11 Modified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These boat tail spitzer bullets will only fall below the speed of sound after traveling across a very long distance. Improved from the standard GP11 rounds, they are K31's favorite ammunition.

specialMagazine.name: Largo Modified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The old cartridge specially modified for Z-62 features an upgrade in the casing material.

specialMagazine.name: Falcon Refined Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The refined cartridge that Falcon picks out after much careful deliberation can pierce through heavy armor with a single shot.

specialMagazine.name: MK5 Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: A signal flare that RO635 often brings along on her missions. It has came in clutch many times when she was in danger, so she can't bear the idea of replacing it even if it gets mocked for being old and battered.

specialMagazine.name: 9x18mm SPK
specialMagazine.description: An improvement based on the classic 9x18 pistol round. The bullet now sports a conical core with greatly enhanced muzzle velocity. A favorite of Shipka's.

specialMagazine.name: .303 Bren Rounds
specialMagazine.description: A round named after Bren which represents her pride and determination to grow stronger.

specialMagazine.name: Magnum Augmented Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Optimization made to the classic magnum cartridge design improves the stability of the trajectory and firing distance. Wear and tear on the barrel is also significantly reduced.

specialMagazine.name: PKP Custom Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Cartridge hand-picked and commissioned by PKP herself. Many improvements have been made according to her own combat needs, so these rounds are for her exclusive use.

specialMagazine.name: USP Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: A signal flare exclusively issued to USP Compact that gives her the ability to call for help when she is in danger.

specialMagazine.name: XD 9mm +P Rounds
specialMagazine.description: 9mm +P ammo that I.O.P developed exclusively for Vector. The new cartridge design rectifies Vector's poor compatibility with +P ammo. The adoption of XD rounds also provides a massive boost in lethality.

specialMagazine.name: M33 Type Augmented Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Upgraded and enhanced from the original .50 BMG design, these new rounds now pack an even heavier punch.

specialMagazine.name: WM Augmented Rounds
specialMagazine.description: An improvement to the classic design, it carries a heavier punch whilst having greater compatibility with the weapon.

specialMagazine.name: IS Infanterie Spitz Round
specialMagazine.description: Rounds specially configured for G41, granting improvements to penetrative capabilities.

specialMagazine.name: DM21 Round-Nosed Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These new rounds feature improved energy transfer on their target as well as better precision. They're pretty good in CQC.

specialMagazine.name: Colt Signal Flare
specialMagazine.description: For any old western, a signal of victory must be fired for a duel. Perhaps a good 'ol bottle of genuine cola can act as one.

specialMagazine.name: HS Augmented Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Augmented 12.7mm rounds belonging to HS.50, further improving her firepower against her enemies.

specialMagazine.name: Multi-Purpose Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These rounds developed specifically for M82A1 have formidable penetrating power that can make short work of enemies on the battlefield.

specialMagazine.name: .440 DE Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Combining the bottleneck cartridge case with a .44 caliber bullet, these rounds are a bit more compact than the usual pistol ammunition, much to Desert Eagle's delight.

specialMagazine.name: TLL Amplified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: .223 caliber rifle rounds specially developed for AK-Alfa. The design incorporates elements of sci-fi.

specialMagazine.name: 6.5mm CM Rounds
specialMagazine.description: With special modifications made for long-range precision shooting, the rounds' ballistic performance has been significantly improved.

specialMagazine.name: Mark V Flaregun
specialMagazine.description: A sporterized version of its original design, it can effectively relay information to nearby teammates.

specialMagazine.name: Beretta Flaregun
specialMagazine.description: Beretta Model 38 carries this flaregun with her at all times. It can fires signal flares for communications and rescue.

specialMagazine.name: GL Amplified Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Rounds specially customized to Galil's preferences. They boast impressive firepower.

specialMagazine.name: 12.7mm KD Rounds
specialMagazine.description: This classic design uses new propellant technology to greatly increase chamber pressures. Its explosive filler has also been improved and it boasts incredible destructive power.

specialMagazine.name: L-Type Light Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These modernized L-type rounds feature greatly improved muzzle velocity over the base model.

specialMagazine.name: Modernized M91 Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These new-model rounds apply brand new technology to a classic design, flattening bullet trajectories and reducing recoil.

specialMagazine.name: Tornado Tomahawk
specialMagazine.description: A CZ75-only weapon furnished with an ACOG sight, which solves the handling problem. No other Doll can master this weapon.

specialMagazine.name: PAB Subsonic Rounds
specialMagazine.description: The steel core of these rounds has been completely redesigned, featuring greatly-increased hardness and accuracy.

specialMagazine.name: APFSDS
specialMagazine.description: Armor-piercing fin-stabilized discarding sabot rounds specially designed for IWS2000. They allow her to penetrate thick armor at long range and boast startling firepower.

specialMagazine.name: Modern Mk Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These rounds are made with the latest technology and are very suitable for Lewis' combat style.

specialMagazine.name: 7.62 Nagant Rounds
specialMagazine.description: It retains the classic cased cartridge design but features improved muzzle velocity.

specialMagazine.name: Sten Pistol Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Its new design allows for convenient and smooth feeding and ejection of cartridges, greatly reducing the chances of stoppages.

specialMagazine.name: 7.63 Mauser Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These Mauser rounds feature the same old classical design with improved penetration, and their power is every bit a match for more modern rounds.

specialMagazine.name: G3 Special Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These rounds were specially designed for Gr G3. They are a balanced design that combine range, power and recoil control.

specialMagazine.name: SC Special Rounds
specialMagazine.description: Modern rounds that are perfectly suited for Gr G36, they have impressive killing power and can effectively suppress their target's movements.

specialMagazine.name: KR Rifle Rounds
specialMagazine.description: These bullets were specially designed for the Kar98k and have greatly improved power and penetration ability.

specialDollEquipment.name: Titan Fire-Control Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A fire-control chip that provides an overall increase to specific machine guns' firepower output. It looks strangely familiar for some reason. Can only be equipped by M1918.

specialDollEquipment.name: GSG UX Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A dedicated high-performance exoskeleton specially calibrated for MP5 which maximizes her mobility and evasive capabilities. Can only be equipped by MP5.

specialDollEquipment.name: Hayha Memory Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A memory chip that allows the White Death to once more descend upon the battlefield. Can only be equipped by Mosin-Nagant.

specialDollEquipment.name: Special Warfare Mobile Suit
specialDollEquipment.description: A legacy equipment from before Sangvis Ferris Manufacturing went rogue, it integrates a mobile exoskeleton with durable armor to greatly increase the user's survivability. However, it causes great physical and mental stress to the user.

specialDollEquipment.name: UMP UX Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A highly mobile exoskeleton specially calibrated for T-Dolls of the UMP weapons platform by the former Equipment Department. It greatly increases evasive ability while preserving firing accuracy.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Memory Module
specialDollEquipment.description: Who knew that memory sticks are still a rare luxury in the year of 2063. This Holiday Limited Edition high-performance memory module is both a rare collector's item and an important strategic equipment. Can only be equipped by Ameli.

specialDollEquipment.name: Inherited Case
specialDollEquipment.description: A departing gift that had witnessed many unsung wars and heroes without tombstones from an old veteran. It has been calibrated for M4A1.

specialDollEquipment.name: Performance+ Cartridge
specialDollEquipment.description: Looks like an antiquated cartridge. Hard to believe that you can increase combat performance just by plugging it in. You should probably blow into it before use. Can only be equipped by IDW.

specialDollEquipment.name: Infinite Ammo Box
specialDollEquipment.description: A mysterious and powerful equipment left over from ancient times. Although most of these had been confiscated by a certain mysterious authority, one copy has been preserved to this day. Can only be equipped by MG3.

specialDollEquipment.name: Blue Thick Cape
specialDollEquipment.description: A cape once worn by a mysterious girl named Pavlichenko, it is able to withstand the piercing cold of Siberia. Can only be equipped by PTRD.

specialDollEquipment.name: Digital Camouflage
specialDollEquipment.description: A winter digital camouflage cloak suitable for SV-98's operational environments. Increases damage and critical hit damage. Can only be equipped by SV-98.

specialDollEquipment.name: Hi-Performance Tactical Hair Accessory
specialDollEquipment.description: This strange-looking sphere-shaped hair accessory used by Gr G41 is equipped with a fire control chip that improves both her ability to detect enemies and her aim. When it turns red, she'll be in grave danger and need to be return for immediate repairs.

specialDollEquipment.name: Powdered Delta
specialDollEquipment.description: The sour component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialDollEquipment.name: Karmotrine
specialDollEquipment.description: The alcoholic component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialDollEquipment.name: Prosthetic Arm
specialDollEquipment.description: Dana's cybernetic arm. She has never revealed the story of how she lost her real arm.

specialDollEquipment.name: White Knight's Armor
specialDollEquipment.description: Armor made for White Knights. It rapidly heals its wearer's wounds.

specialDollEquipment.name: Prosthetic Eye
specialDollEquipment.description: In her youth, Stella lost an eye when she was attacked by thugs, so she has used an electronic eye ever since.

specialDollEquipment.name: Cybernetic Hands
specialDollEquipment.description: In order to avoid long-term Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (and also to install other useful functions), Alma underwent surgery to have her hands replaced with electronic prostheses.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Headwear
specialDollEquipment.description: After 416's Neural Upgrade, she is equipped with all new Enhanced Situational Awareness System. It may look like a simple hairpin, but on the contrary it has 22 sensors and antennas of various types built-in to greatly enhance HK416's combat efficiency.

specialDollEquipment.name: RPD Infantry Webbing
specialDollEquipment.description: A piece of infantry equipment produced by a certain Eastern faction before the War. Light and practical, it's very popular among certain collectors. People often bug RPD to sell it to them at a high price when she goes on security missions, much to her chagrin.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Earphones
specialDollEquipment.description: TAR-21's trademark headwear. It looks like a set of bunny ears but contains many sensors, allowing her to accurately pinpoint targets without exposing herself from behind cover.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Thunderbolt Ahoge
specialDollEquipment.description: Many Commanders have been bothered by how Stechkin's lightning bolt-shaped ahoge can move around so nimbly and vigorously. They secretly considered it to be an overly eye-catching element of her design, until one day P7 found out that Stechkin detaches it and puts it aside to charge while she sleeps.

specialDollEquipment.name: Duelling Cards
specialDollEquipment.description: They may have been given a cool name, but they're still nothing more than toys for building a house of cards – one of the few things that a cyborg created for destruction can make.

specialDollEquipment.name: Fairy Tale Picture Books
specialDollEquipment.description: A girl's dreams and memories are stored within these fairy tale picture books. No matter when or where, just seeing them is reassuring.

specialDollEquipment.name: G-box
specialDollEquipment.description: A mysterious storage container developed especially for Gr G11. Supposedly, it was originally designed as nothing more than a portable Doll power supply. The final version of the G-Box also stores Gr G11's personal items and is essentially a mobile lifestyle terminal for her. According to Gr G11, it has a great deal of tactical value to her.

specialDollEquipment.name: Beloved Dangle
specialDollEquipment.description: A multipurpose dangle developed especially for RO635 which combines stress relief, alarm, load-bearing and many other functions into one package. Supposedly, a certain Doll barged into the lab during the development process and forced the designers to make it in her own image.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Riot Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A highly maneuverable ballistic shield that IOP developed for Type 97S. Its simple structure and plain appearance belies its reliable nature.

specialDollEquipment.name: Mk31 Multi-functional Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: This high-performance leg exoskeleton was developed for Suomi and features a small waldo arm to facilitate user operation. A cutting-edge exoskeleton that combines ease of use and mobility.

specialDollEquipment.name: Go-Bag "V"
specialDollEquipment.description: A bespoke Go-Bag for Agent Vector. The compact storage bag is functional and does not slow Vector down.

specialDollEquipment.name: 416's Go-Bag
specialDollEquipment.description: A Go-Bag modified from the SHD's standard issue version to better suit 416's individual needs.

specialDollEquipment.name: Galil Special Handguards
specialDollEquipment.description: Modular handguards specially developed for the Galil rifle. The brand new M-LOK system allows for many more possibilities.

specialDollEquipment.name: Special Ops Bag
specialDollEquipment.description: A multi-functional gear bag developed for Welrod. It appears to be an ordinary briefcase but in truth, it contains a great deal of firepower and a tactical shield in case of emergencies.

specialDollEquipment.name: Survival Expert
specialDollEquipment.description: A machete made especially for F1. An essential tool for jungle operations.

specialDollEquipment.name: High-Performance Camouflaged Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: An exoskeleton custom-fitted for Type 64. This exoskeleton was designed for practicality and greatly improves her mobility while including camouflaged armor panels.

specialDollEquipment.name: Thompson's Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: How heavy is a Thompson submachine gun when it's fitted with a drum magazine? About as much as two M4s put together. Hardly what you'd consider a "light" weapon. This specialized exoskeleton improves her mobility on the battlefield.

specialDollEquipment.name: MkV Mobility Skeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A new type of mobility skeleton developed at Grizzly's behest. It looks retro but is surprisingly powerful. Grizzly's favorite.

specialDollEquipment.name: Wing-Shaped Mechanical Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: It may have the appearance of a pair of wings, but it doesn't seem to be capable of flight. A shield for RMB-93's exclusive use.

specialDollEquipment.name: 9A High-Performance Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: An upgrade chip developed specially for 9A-91 that greatly enhances her performance.

specialDollEquipment.name: MkQ Light Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A new specialized exoskeleton designed specially for Honey Badger under the codename "Q". The streamlined shape and rose gold color give the design a very modern flair.

specialDollEquipment.name: Miraculous Curry Ladle
specialDollEquipment.description: "There's nothing that a pot of curry can't solve. If there is, then—" says Jashin-chan as she stirs the curry in the pot, but the next second, this ladle is all that remains before Yurine.

specialDollEquipment.name: Donut of Sweet Dreams
specialDollEquipment.description: An important tool that helps Pekola tell dreams and reality apart. One can only taste such delicious donuts in Heaven, when one is dreaming.

specialDollEquipment.name: Paper Bag Helmet
specialDollEquipment.description: Not all helmets are indestructible. Some helmets are made of nothing but a thin piece of kraft paper. Put it on, and no humans will ever be petrified again. Take it off, and you will gain the power to protect your friends.

specialDollEquipment.name: MICO
specialDollEquipment.description: An ammo backpack specially designed for machine guns by TYR Tactical. After modification by IOP, it is now FF M249SAW's personal backpack.

specialDollEquipment.name: Old Camouflage Uniform
specialDollEquipment.description: An old camouflage cape that Mondragon M1908 always carries with her. The scars of battle left on it speak of the glories of past battlefields.

specialDollEquipment.name: 4X Auxiliary Processor
specialDollEquipment.description: A specialized auxiliary processor designed for Gr G36c by IOP. It greatly improves her neutral cloud computational capacity.

specialDollEquipment.name: Perst-4
specialDollEquipment.description: This Perst-4 laser aiming device was specially prepared for use by AK-15 after her neural upgrade. Its internals have been modified and fitted with DEFY-only microchips, allowing the LAD's targeting information to be shared withiun the team.

specialDollEquipment.name: Nano Multi-function Cape
specialDollEquipment.description: A multi-function cape developed by IOP for M6 ASW. Created using advanced materials, it is bullet-proof to a certain degree.

specialDollEquipment.name: Garde du Corps Uniform
specialDollEquipment.description: An outfit created to fit Kar98k's image. The elaborate design utilizes the latest bulletproof materials and also possesses the functionality necessary for a sharpshooting Doll.

specialDollEquipment.name: RS Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A chip for Type 56-1's use that effectively increases her combat performance.

specialDollEquipment.name: MAB High-Power Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A new exoskeleton that IOP developed for PA-15. It has a built-in chip that syncs combat data with PA-15's neural cloud, which greatly enhances her combat efficiency.

specialDollEquipment.name: Bento of Love
specialDollEquipment.description: A bento box that Ai Mizuno uses regularly. There's nothing remarkable about the box itself. What IS remarkable is the love goes into filling this bento box.

specialDollEquipment.name: Ozaki Figurine
specialDollEquipment.description: A figurine that is allegedly made in the Commander's image, though the subject and the artist have contrasting views regarding how good the likeness is.

specialDollEquipment.name: Leader's Armband
specialDollEquipment.description: An armband with "Franchouchou" written in Man'yogana. A certain ex-biker tried to campaign for it to be worn, but her teammates shot down the idea unanimously.

specialDollEquipment.name: M2 Tripod Mk2
specialDollEquipment.description: An M2 Tripod that IOP modified for M1919A4. Produced with new materials, the tripod has better recoil absorption and is more light-weight.

specialDollEquipment.name: Daewoo Exoskeleton Mk5
specialDollEquipment.description: A custom exoskeleton developed using K5's combat data. It can drastically boost her combat efficiency.

specialDollEquipment.name: STM Assault Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A brand new custom assault shield modified from DP-12's original shield. It is now a lot lighter and has better anti-ballistic properties.

specialDollEquipment.name: mk87 Improved Assault Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: IOP modified M1887's original shield by modularizing it and improving both its craftsmanship and bulletproofness.

specialDollEquipment.name: Custom Comms Headset
specialDollEquipment.description: Gr MG4's most frequently worn headgear. With minimal sound leakage, these headphones ensure clear communication even in noisy environments and are excellent in maintaining secrecy.

specialDollEquipment.name: SAAB Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A custom exoskeleton that IOP developed exclusively for C-MS. Sporting C-MS's preferred graffiti, it effectively increases the Doll's combat performance.

specialDollEquipment.name: PM High-Performance Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A high-performance exoskeleton tailor-made for Makarov. It comes with small ballistic armor, which further enhances the toughness of the exoskeleton.

specialDollEquipment.name: Medal of Honor
specialDollEquipment.description: The two medals that PPSh-41 has treasured for a long time contain memories of past glory. No, they are not rewards for taking the blame for server crashes!

specialDollEquipment.name: C96 Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: A new model of exoskeleton custom-made for C96 that is highly conducive to meeting the physical demand of prolonged battles, making it C96's favorite piece of equipment.

specialDollEquipment.name: Police Uniform of Justice
specialDollEquipment.description: A jacket that VSK-94 has been wearing since her time in the police force. It still looks cool and dandy even after having been through years of fighting.

specialDollEquipment.name: Multi-Purpose Crinoline
specialDollEquipment.description: A special crinoline that IOP designed specially for PPK that can effectively maintain the Doll's balance in combat and does not hinder her movements even when she is moving at high speed.

specialDollEquipment.name: TC High-Performance Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: An exoskeleton designed specially for Contender that improves her firing consistency and performance in high-intensity battles.

specialDollEquipment.name: Teddy Bear Auxiliary Processor
specialDollEquipment.description: A processor designed according to AS Val's personal request. It is loaded with special features... Let's hope it won't interfere with her missions.

specialDollEquipment.name: Beretta Custom Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: An enhancement chip custom made for AR70 that greatly improves the potency of her attacks.

specialDollEquipment.name: Patrol Helmet
specialDollEquipment.description: A helmet that M870 claims to have frequently worn when she was on duty on highways. It apparently had quite the deterrent effect that aided in her efforts in law enforcement.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Headdress
specialDollEquipment.description: Type 88's favorite headdress. It serves as a constant reminder to never lose her poise as a maid.

specialDollEquipment.name: Panda Dangle
specialDollEquipment.description: CF05's favourite multi-purpose dangle. Seeing it always reminds her of home.

specialDollEquipment.name: Woodland Camouflage Cloak
specialDollEquipment.description: The most suitable gear for carrying out missions in woodland. It is exceptionally light and portable, probably to make it easier for NTW-20 to maneuver her motorbike with only one hand.

specialDollEquipment.name: Multi-Purpose Headset
specialDollEquipment.description: A piece of hair accessory constantly worn by Gr G3. It seems to be the Doll's signal receiver, so please do not remove it!

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Defense Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: The high-performance bulletproof shield designed by IOP for Liberator features immaculate structural balance.

specialDollEquipment.name: High-Speed Processor
specialDollEquipment.description: The new upgrade on the second-generation processor developed by IOP greatly enhances the chip's processing speed.

specialDollEquipment.name: TMP Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: The exoskeleton tailor-made for TMP features aesthetic and structural designs requested and deeply appreciated by the Doll.

specialDollEquipment.name: Medal of the Lion
specialDollEquipment.description: A medal specially made to commend EVO 3's conscientiousness. The design features various elements from her hometown.

specialDollEquipment.name: The Queen's Cape
specialDollEquipment.description: The cape was apparently a purchase that Px4 Storm made only after very careful calculations to effectively minimize the danger she faces during operations.

specialDollEquipment.name: JS Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: This chip for EM-2's exclusive use effectively improves her ability to calculate variables and formulate plans.

specialDollEquipment.name: FA Prototype Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: An exoskeleton with new upgrades based on M950A's previously broken one, but no changes have been made to its appearance, allegedly to commemorate the friend who gave her the equipment.

specialDollEquipment.name: Type 64 Lightweight Rig
specialDollEquipment.description: A piece of military equipment designed specially for LWMMG. Made of cost-effective materials, it is very tough and durable.

specialDollEquipment.name: Crisp Leather Jacket
specialDollEquipment.description: A leather jacket with a common silhouette and texture. The scratches on the elbows and back add to its mystique.

specialDollEquipment.name: Spare Eyeball
specialDollEquipment.description: A state-of-the-art prosthetic eyeball that makes it very easy for the wearer to identify a target's mental weakness. However, Purin has been specifically forbidden from using it out of combat.

specialDollEquipment.name: Maid Exclusive Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A high-performance chip custom made for Gr G36 which will prevent miscalculations even at the busiest of times.

specialDollEquipment.name: AA Combat Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A combat shield designed by AA-12 herself. It has many features that she likes, and it is the one and only shield she takes with her on every mission.

specialDollEquipment.name: FMG Protective Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: PP-90's most frequently used exoskeleton, which offers effective protection against enemy attacks.

specialDollEquipment.name: Special Combat Uniform
specialDollEquipment.description: A combat uniform tailor-made for Type 79 that is suited to almost any harsh combat environment.

specialDollEquipment.name: HB Ammo Box
specialDollEquipment.description: M2HB's favorite ammo box. It satisfies her desire for carnage.

specialDollEquipment.name: Model Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A chip specially made for Model L. It can allegedly help her strike a better balance between spending her processing power on work and play.

specialDollEquipment.name: Custom Combat Motorbike
specialDollEquipment.description: Rex Zero 1's favorite motorcycle. She loves being a speed demon on the battlefield.

specialDollEquipment.name: Nocturnal Cape
specialDollEquipment.description: A cape that Gd DSR-50 often brings along. It comes in handy in both battles and night-time operations.

specialDollEquipment.name: STEN-Exclusive Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: An exoskeleton designed for STEN MkII's exclusive use. It improves her mobility, but there are still some tiny design flaws.

specialDollEquipment.name: Black Bunny Cap
specialDollEquipment.description: SR-3MP's favorite hat. Other than aesthetics and practicality, she almost seems taller wearing it.

specialDollEquipment.name: StG44 Exclusive Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: An exclusive chip for StG44 after her comprehensive performance upgrade, allowing StG44 to be even more meticulous in carrying out her tasks.

specialDollEquipment.name: Winter Frost VI
specialDollEquipment.description: The piece of equipment that AK-12 brought with herself when she withdrew from Avernus is a 6th-gen tactical cape developed by Paradeus that can render her invisible. When inactive, the material is semi-translucent and incredibly light, almost like a thin layer of mist.

specialDollEquipment.name: Cloak of Glory
specialDollEquipment.description: Webley's most cherished attire, even among her lavish wardrobe; embodies courage and determination during the long march towards triumph.

specialDollEquipment.name: M1895 Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: An exoskeleton with extraordinary performance specially made to fit M1895's collecting habits, further enhancing her movement capabilities.

specialDollEquipment.name: GH Heavy Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A ballistic shield specially fitted for SPAS-12. It is immeasurably hefty, but provides a great sense of security.

specialDollEquipment.name: Angel Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: Equipment specially created for medical Dolls, used to great effect during rescue operations. HS2000 loves using this series of exoskeletons.

specialDollEquipment.name: No. 1 Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: Supposedly the only requirement KLIN had for this exoskeleton was that it had to be No. 1, just like herself!

specialDollEquipment.name: Dowel's Visor
specialDollEquipment.description: A protective visor for M500 and her perfect partner, Dowel. Shines in extreme weather conditions.

specialDollEquipment.name: Am RFB Processor
specialDollEquipment.description: A specially ordered high-performance processor for Am RFB, for improving her performance in gami—I mean, combat!

specialDollEquipment.name: Zas Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A chip specially configured for Zas M21, customized in colors according to her wishes whilst providing unbelievable processing speed.

specialDollEquipment.name: Medkit
specialDollEquipment.description: A medkit frequently used by Evita. Apart from the usual first-aid supplies, it apparently contains something else.

specialDollEquipment.name: Alloy Carabiner
specialDollEquipment.description: A climbing tool that Hecate always keeps on her person. She often polishes it and fiddles with it even though it shows no signs of use.

specialDollEquipment.name: CR Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: This chip, which has been upgraded to suit specific modules, provides CR-21 with everything she needs during training.

specialDollEquipment.name: DF Assault Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: Defender's most commonly used equipment. It effectively relieves her tension and also controls her emotional module to a certain extent.

specialDollEquipment.name: Multi-Purpose Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: This exoskeleton created specifically for MP41 is very much to her liking. She always brings it along when she is deployed on missions.

specialDollEquipment.name: Type 92 Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: It's made of very common materials. While its performance isn't the best, its performance-to-cost ratio is extremely high.

specialDollEquipment.name: Old-Fashioned Flip Phone
specialDollEquipment.description: This old-fashioned cellphone modified by MDR herself meets her general communication needs and achieves the key-press hand feel that she desires.

specialDollEquipment.name: Tactical Jacket
specialDollEquipment.description: This piece of carefully designed and revamped tactical equipment looks no different from any other ordinary jacket, but is in fact packed full of special features.

specialDollEquipment.name: FP Wingshields
specialDollEquipment.description: A set of wing-shaped shields. Their movement is more fluid than others styles and they are FP-6's most commonly used piece of equipment.

specialDollEquipment.name: Reactive Armor Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A reactive armor suite unique to S.A.T.8, able to go head to head with grenades, shells and even missiles.

specialDollEquipment.name: New Custom Bag
specialDollEquipment.description: A unique, custom-made piece of infantry gear, it has high storage capacity and can features compartments to sort its contents. Its usage is also very unique.

specialDollEquipment.name: ST Exoskeleton
specialDollEquipment.description: P30 placed a special request for this exoskeleton so she can deliver swift revenge to the people who bullied her!

specialDollEquipment.name: Squirrel Processor
specialDollEquipment.description: A processor chip specially designed for P90, it improves her mimicry skills in an intangible manner.

specialDollEquipment.name: Glorious Banner
specialDollEquipment.description: A flag and pole set that seems to be C-93's constant companion. Supposedly it helps her farm aura quickly.

specialDollEquipment.name: Funerary Spencer
specialDollEquipment.description: AUG's favorite cape, filled with a tender yet painful brokenness.

specialDollEquipment.name: Work Apron
specialDollEquipment.description: Springfield usually wears this apron when working in the cafe. Supposedly, the Dolls who see it cheer up immediately~

specialDollEquipment.name: SAF Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A tactical chip specially manufactured for SAF. It emits a pleasant smell when running.

specialDollEquipment.name: Saiga Mobile Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A high-mobility ballistic shield which boasts greatly improved specs after being redesigned, which makes it perfect for Saiga-12.

specialDollEquipment.name: Anti-Blast Bracer
specialDollEquipment.description: A custom-made bracer that Tokarev requested for herself after her upgrade. When you put it on, you feel full of energy.

specialDollEquipment.name: Knight's Greaves
specialDollEquipment.description: Ribeyrolles personally designed these exoskeletal greaves so she could stand on the battlefield. Putting them on allows her to regain lost confidence.

specialDollEquipment.name: FAL Chip
specialDollEquipment.description: A high-performance chip developed for FAL. She designed it personally, so there's no way to mistake it for anything else.

specialDollEquipment.name: CM Personal Load-Bearing Equipment
specialDollEquipment.description: A set of load-bearing equipment with expanded capacity. Even if Chauchat screws up during a mission, she can make up for it by bringing along large amounts of items to solve whatever problems come up.

specialDollEquipment.name: NV Bipod
specialDollEquipment.description: A bipod especially suited for Negev. It doesn't affect firing accuracy much even when folded under the barrel, making it perfect for Negev's ultra-aggressive combat style.

specialDollEquipment.name: MB Defensive Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: A combat shield for M590, it greatly improves her ballistic protection.

specialDollEquipment.name: JS Mobile Shield
specialDollEquipment.description: M1897's favorite shields, they are an eyecatching signature item for her on the battlefield.

specialDollEquipment.name: Stars and Stripes Tie
specialDollEquipment.description: M1911 never leaves home without this tie. It is her favorite accessory.

specialDollEquipment.name: Cowboy Hat
specialDollEquipment.description: This is SAA's most-commonly worn cowboy hat. It symbolizes her confidence and courage.

specialDollEquipment.name: Royal Battle Cloak
specialDollEquipment.description: A cloak that was specially-designed for Lee-Enfield. It is both elegant and handy, making it perfect for use on missions.

suppressor.name: AC1 Suppressor
suppressor.description: A general use suppressor model manufactured by AC Corporation, it helps to keep T-Dolls concealed. Can be equipped by all except MGs and SGs.

suppressor.name: AC2 Suppressor
suppressor.description: An improved suppressor model manufactured by AC Corporation, it helps to keep T-Dolls concealed and reduces their chances of being detected. Can be equipped by all except MGs and SGs.

suppressor.name: AC3 Suppressor
suppressor.description: An advanced general use suppressor model manufactured by AC Corporation, it is effective at keeping T-Dolls concealed and reduces their chances of being detected. Can be equipped by all except MGs and SGs.

suppressor.name: AC4 Suppressor
suppressor.description: A suppressor model specially developed for special operations, it is highly effective at keeping T-Dolls concealed and reduces their chances of being detected. Can be equipped by all except MGs and SGs.

ammunitionBox.name: IOP High-Capacity Ammo Box
ammunitionBox.description: A high-capacity ammunition box specially developed for machine gun T-Dolls by IOP Corporation, it grants them much longer firepower output.

ammunitionBox.name: IOP Maximum Ammo Box
ammunitionBox.description: An extra-large ammunition box specially developed for machine gun T-Dolls by IOP Corporation, it grants them unmatched firepower.

hollowPointAmmo.name: ILM Hollow-Point Ammo
hollowPointAmmo.description: A hollow-point ammunition developed by ILM, it helps to increase lethality against unarmored targets, but lacks penetration when facing armored enemies. Can be equipped by HG and SMGs.

hollowPointAmmo.name: ILM Hollow-Point Ammo
hollowPointAmmo.description: A hollow-point ammunition developed by ILM, it increases lethality against unarmored targets, but lacks penetration when facing armored enemies. Can be equipped by HG and SMGs.

hollowPointAmmo.name: ILM Hollow-Point Ammo
hollowPointAmmo.description: A hollow-point ammunition developed by ILM, it has high lethality against unarmored targets, but lacks penetration when facing armored enemies. Can be equipped by HG and SMGs.

hollowPointAmmo.name: ILM Hollow-Point Ammo
hollowPointAmmo.description: A hollow-point ammunition developed by ILM, it has extreme lethality against unarmored targets, but lacks penetration when facing armored enemies. Can be equipped by HG and SMGs.

hollowPointAmmo.name: 16Lab Hollow-Point
hollowPointAmmo.description: 16Lab's custom hollow-point rounds are the best among hollow-point ammunition that excel in every performance metrics. Can be equipped by HG and SMGs.

hollowPointAmmo.name: Signal Flare
hollowPointAmmo.description: A simple yet reliable flare gun which uses 12-gauge flare shells to aid in efficient communication between T-Dolls on the battlefield. Can be used by handguns and submachine guns.

shotgunShells.name: #1 Buckshot
shotgunShells.description: High-powered shotgun shells issued by IOP. Each shot contains multiple pellets measuring 7.62mm in diameter. Can be equipped by SGs.

shotgunShells.name: #0 Buckshot
shotgunShells.description: Powerful shotgun shells issued by IOP. Each shot contains multiple pellets measuring 8.13mm in diameter. Can be equipped by SGs.

shotgunShells.name: #00 Buckshot
shotgunShells.description: Very powerful shotgun shells issued by IOP. Each shot contains multiple pellets measuring 8.38mm in diameter. Can be equipped by SGs.

shotgunShells.name: #000 Buckshot
shotgunShells.description: Extremely powerful shotgun shells issued by IOP. Each shot contains multiple pellets measuring 9.14mm in diameter. Can be equipped by SGs.

shotgunShells.name: BK Slug
shotgunShells.description: Shotgun slugs issued by IOP. Each shot contains a single large projectile and is designed to deal single-target damage.

shotgunShells.name: FST Slug
shotgunShells.description: Shotgun slugs issued by IOP. With its mass centered in the front, each single large projectile shot is designed to deal accurate single-target damage.

shotgunShells.name: WAD Slug
shotgunShells.description: Shotgun slugs issued by IOP. With its mass centered in the front, each single large projectile shot encased in polymer casing is designed to deal highly accurate single-target damage.

shotgunShells.name: SABOT Slug
shotgunShells.description: Shotgun slugs issued by IOP. After being fired, it gains a steady rotation that provides the shotgun shot with a stable firing trajectory and laser-like precision.

shotgunShells.name: 16Lab Buckshot
shotgunShells.description: 16Lab's custom magnum shotgun shell is one of the strongest shells currently available for shotguns with its high-powered gunpowder and tungsten alloy outer shell encapsuling a lead bullet.

shotgunShells.name: #6 Birdshot
shotgunShells.description: A traditional hunting round designed to deal with smaller targets. The interior of the shell is packed with miniature pellets that improve spread and lethal coverage. Said pellets have also been redesigned by IOP to improve lethality. Can be used by shotguns.

shotgunShells.name: #7.5 Birdshot
shotgunShells.description: #7.5 birdshot is smaller than #6 birdshot, allowing more pellets to be carried in a shell of the same size. This gives it a wider spread than before. Can be used by shotguns.

shotgunShells.name: Shotgun Flash Shells
shotgunShells.description: A type of flashbang which can be fired from shotguns. It is not particularly lethal but can debilitate the enemy, thus reducing the damage taken by friendly Dolls and improving their accuracy. Can be used by shotguns.

specialAccessories.name: KSTSP
specialAccessories.description: An optical scope developed by KSTSP before the war, it is specially designed to fit onto the AK family of weapons. Due to its unrivaled precision, it is still the accessory of choice for the AK variants to this day.

specialAccessories.name: KST1P8
specialAccessories.description: An optical scope meticulously developed by KST with accuracy and precision before the war, it is specially designed to fit onto the AK family of weapons. Due to its precision and durability, it is still favored for the AK variants to this day.

specialAccessories.name: KST1P7
specialAccessories.description: An optical scope developed by KST before the war, it is specially designed to fit onto the AK family of weapons. It is still a decent choice for the AK variants to this day.

specialAccessories.name: PKN03M Night Vision Scope
specialAccessories.description: A night vision scope developed under the request of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. It has a 3x magnification capability and an infrared designator, allowing 9A-91 to silently strike enemy vital points in the dead of night.

specialAccessories.name: Lightweight Rail Kit
specialAccessories.description: Equipment designed to be lightweight and to maintain stability while shooting at high rates of fire. Includes keymod rails, front grip, muzzle compensator, and a free-floating barrel. Increases crit damage and accuracy. Can only be equipped by AR15.

specialAccessories.name: Type 64 Exclusive Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: This quaint suppressor allows Type 64 to silently blend into the darkness of the rainforest night while increasing her critical strike chance. Can only be equipped by Type 64.

specialAccessories.name: Fire Selector
specialAccessories.description: A fire selector for later versions of the rifle. A FN49 equipped with this can freely switch between semi-auto and fully-auto. Increases rate of fire and critical strike chance. Can only be equipped by FN49.

specialAccessories.name: PM 5-25X56
specialAccessories.description: The expensive German-made optical lens has always been the ultimate choice for snipers and photographers. For someone who has toured through 130 years of battlefields, this sophisticated sight will allow her to be even more serene. Can only be equipped by Kar98k.

specialAccessories.name: EOT XPS3
specialAccessories.description: EOT's latest holographic sight. In addition to looking cool, it comes with a flip to side 3x magnifier scope, allowing it to be used under a wider range of situations. Can only be equipped by 416.

specialAccessories.name: K6-24X56
specialAccessories.description: This modern optical sight installed on rails unleashes the full potential of Mosin-Nagant by increasing its accuracy and critical hit rate. Can only be equipped by Mosin-Nagant.

specialAccessories.name: CT 4X20
specialAccessories.description: Originally developed for the AR platform, this battle-proven scope has been retrofitted for M1918. Can only be equipped by M1918.

specialAccessories.name: M1895 Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: Most revolvers cannot be suppressed due to the large physical gaps in their designs, but the unique structure of M1895 allows for the installation of a suppressor. It becomes very effective when paired with special reduced noise ammunition. Can only be equipped by M1895.

specialAccessories.name: MP446C Match Barrel
specialAccessories.description: With improvements in accuracy, this 120mm match barrel upgrades MP-446 into the more versatile 446C. Can only be equipped by MP-446.

specialAccessories.name: Glorylight
specialAccessories.description: A radiant light born from a clear soul of an alternate world. It seeks to bring you, who is lost in the darkness, hope and strength. "Glory day, glory light, you are the only one, you are the light!"

specialAccessories.name: Black Cat
specialAccessories.description: A searing light manifested from a chaotic soul of an alternate world. It seeks to remind you, who lost in the darkness, to never forget, "I will always break the rules, no matter how many times!"

specialAccessories.name: FÉLIN System Sight
specialAccessories.description: Once a part of an advanced infantry combat system, this hardware incorporates an optical sight and an infrared laser into one single unit, allowing Fr FAMAS to flexibly adapt to the battle environment.

specialAccessories.name: SAA Long Barrel
specialAccessories.description: A long-barreled SAA, spurred boots, and a neatly trimmed mustache are important features of a wild west protagonist. Perhaps a bottle of cola from the old days too.

specialAccessories.name: Bren L4 Barrel Kit
specialAccessories.description: Installing this L4 barrel kit allows Bren to fire 7.62x51mm NATO rounds. Increases damage and accuracy but decreases rate of fire. Can only be equipped by Bren.

specialAccessories.name: Gr G3 Barrel Kit
specialAccessories.description: This heavy barrel kit provides Gr G3 with a higher stability and reduced bullet spread. Its roller-delayed blowback design increases accuracy comparable to sniper rifles.

specialAccessories.name: Additional Computing Module
specialAccessories.description: A chip upgrade developed especially for UMP45 to improve her basic performance and more importantly, effectively solve the problem of electronic warfare T-Dolls not being able to have complex fire control systems installed.

specialAccessories.name: Dinergate RO
specialAccessories.description: By establishing a data sharing link with RO536's neural cloud, M4 SOPMOD II's ability to react to different scenarios on the battlefield has been improved dramatically. This Dinergate can see further than any of her kind, all because she's standing on M4 SOPMOD II's shoulder.

specialAccessories.name: STEN Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: Once widely used in the battlefields of Europe and the Pacific theater, this quaint-looking suppressor comes standard with a canvas cover that shields against heat generated during firing. Can only be equipped by STEN MkⅡ.

specialAccessories.name: M2 Bipod
specialAccessories.description: This time-honored foldable bipod which improves shooting stability had been issued to M14s for a brief period of time in the past. Can only be equipped by M14.

specialAccessories.name: Gr G36 Hybrid Sight
specialAccessories.description: A hybrid sight developed especially for Gr G36. It comprises of a 3x optical sight on the bottom and a red dot sight on top, allowing for flexible usage to suit the needs of the operational environment. Can only be equipped by Gr G36.

specialAccessories.name: MGO 6X48
specialAccessories.description: A red dot sight optimized for machine guns by TJC. It increases fire suppression efficiency with its 6x magnification and built-in rangefinder. Can only be equipped by LWMMG.

specialAccessories.name: Gr MG4 MGO
specialAccessories.description: A red dot sight optimized for machine guns by TJC. It boasts a 6x magnification and built-in rangefinder. The Bundeswehr camo makes it cost twice as much. Can only be equipped by Gr MG4.

specialAccessories.name: Stechkin Buttstock
specialAccessories.description: Although the newer resin buttstock is lighter, everyone knows that a classic, weather-beaten solid wood buttstock is the only choice for a self respecting Stechkin. Can only be equipped by Stechkin.

specialAccessories.name: MPL M21
specialAccessories.description: Designed for the tough environment of the Middle East, this red dot sight has an optical fiber crosshair lighted by radium. No battery needed. Can only be equipped by Micro Uzi.

specialAccessories.name: Adelhyde
specialAccessories.description: The sweet component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialAccessories.name: Flanergide
specialAccessories.description: The spicy component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialAccessories.name: Karmotrine
specialAccessories.description: The alcoholic component of drinks. Issued by the BTC.

specialAccessories.name: ZFG42
specialAccessories.description: ZF's optical sight for FG42. Its brass exterior has faded after more than a century, but you can still get a sense of the German style from the lens. Looking through it makes you feel like you've joined Magnum.

specialAccessories.name: SIG-510 Fire Selector
specialAccessories.description: Designed for SIG-510, the fire selector can be freely switched between single shot and fully automatic, allowing for full adaptability in the ever-changing battlefield.

specialAccessories.name: VM59 Heavy Barrel
specialAccessories.description: Equipped with a heavy barrel, VM59 Mark IV will not overheat with sustained fire, allowing it to play the role of fire support.

specialAccessories.name: OSS Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: A suppressor developed by OSS back in the day for covert operations. In addition to concealing M3, it also comes with a cowhide cover that the Commander can use as emergency field ration.

specialAccessories.name: PPK Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: Other than lipstick, a lady will also always need a suppressor in her bag. The former keeps people talking, and the latter will ensure their silence forever.

specialAccessories.name: AMP COMPSP
specialAccessories.description: AMP's exclusive optical sight for UMP9. The main feature is that the built-in 4MOA crosshair is bright yellow, just the way UMP9 likes it. Can only be equipped by UMP9.

specialAccessories.name: LED Weapon Light
specialAccessories.description: The bright LED flashlight is integrated into the handguard with a built-in lithium battery. It can be quickly turned on and off with the press of a button on the handguard. Can only be equipped by Gr MP5.

specialAccessories.name: Acceleration Coil
specialAccessories.description: Abandoning the outdated propellant propulsion method of lead delivery, the newly upgraded Type88 is now equipped with a high-performance acceleration coil, which can accelerate projectiles to Mach 1.5 in 0.2 seconds. Isn't this a bit overpowered?

specialAccessories.name: No32 MKI
specialAccessories.description: Telescopic sight produced exclusively for Lee Enfield No. 4 MK. I (T) at the beginning of the last century, furnished with an exquisite brass finish. The faded scope lens witnessed countless lives lost. Can only be equipped by Lee Enfield.

specialAccessories.name: Advanced Infantry Sight
specialAccessories.description: An integrated sight with wired transmission and a rangefinder, it is designed to enhance the battlefield awareness and combat adaptability of Type95 and Type97, allowing them to not reveal themselves while shooting from behind cover.

specialAccessories.name: MAX10 Upper Receiver
specialAccessories.description: A modified upper receiver for exclusive use with Ingram. It adds a rail system that increases flexibility in equipping tactical accessories while also reducing the weapon's cyclic rate, allowing her fire control module to control it more easily. Most importantly, it looks REALLY cool.
