specialAccessories.name: M9 BC2 Grips
specialAccessories.description: A set of modified synthetic tactical grips for exclusive use with M9. They provide an underbarrel Picatinny rail mount and improve controllability while also increasing flexibility in equipping tactical accessories.

specialAccessories.name: DO Reflex Sight
specialAccessories.description: This reflex sight has a 7 MOA dot. Its small size and easy handling made it very popular in the pre-war civilian market. When attached to an M38 via a welded Picatinny rail, it greatly improves the user experience.

specialAccessories.name: C96 Oak Stock
specialAccessories.description: A real wooden stock that was specially made for the Mauser C96, it improves accuracy when firing multiple rounds in succession and is decorated with a cloth sleeve that matches the Doll's clothing. You can even store some snacks in it. All in all, it's incredibly practical.

specialAccessories.name: Folding Stock
specialAccessories.description: A folding stock specially designed for paratroopers to use in battle. What sets it apart from the more common metal folding stock used on other firearms is that this stock is made of wood, combined with a metal folding mechanism. Can only be equipped by 100 Shiki.

specialAccessories.name: Am RFB Quad Rail
specialAccessories.description: Insufficient space is often a problem when mounting accessories onto bullpup assault rifles. Thanks to this three-inch quad rail produced by the original manufacturer KTC, the tactical Christmas tree is no longer dominated by standard firearms. Can only be equipped by Am RFB.

specialAccessories.name: ART2
specialAccessories.description: A scope for accurate firing. M21 delights in the distinctive golden eyepiece rim.

specialAccessories.name: BPR4 & SRM6
specialAccessories.description: An OSS suppressor kit designed for .308 and 7.62mm caliber firearms. Due to the modular structure and chic look, it has gone viral on Griffin's discussion board. A certain frequent user of the anonymous forum obviously won't miss out on it.

specialAccessories.name: MGP Upgrade Kit
specialAccessories.description: An upgrade kit manufactured by a renowned gun accessories firm. The M-LOK system grants incredible adaptability and the length of the stock is now more suited for the average Doll.

specialAccessories.name: WML & Tactical Handguard
specialAccessories.description: A tactical handguard installed after M950A's remodel. Its four rails give her more choice in accessories, but at the same time, M950A's been complaining about how heavy the front of the gun has become, leading to increased training costs.

specialAccessories.name: Tactical Grip
specialAccessories.description: A tactical grip designed for the Makarov PM by a renowned manufacturer. It comes with a quick-release for the magazine. It also sits a lot more comfortably in the hand - so comfortably, you'll never want to put it down.

specialAccessories.name: Spectacles
specialAccessories.description: A pair of spectacles that bore witness to a vow between two people. They aren't corrective, but they do let her look at the world with more composure.

specialAccessories.name: Antique Kaleidoscope
specialAccessories.description: A kaleidoscope of intricate craftsmanship. Its owner doesn't care if it's genuine or counterfeit. What matters to her is the sentimental value it carries.

specialAccessories.name: Meteorite
specialAccessories.description: No amount of fire and blood will ever consume such genuine feelings.

specialAccessories.name: Wristwatch
specialAccessories.description: Living a regimented life is also a solid kind of happiness.

specialAccessories.name: ACS-L
specialAccessories.description: A synthetic stock developed by MGP. There is a small storage compartment in the back that can hold various tools. The broad stock also increases the user's comfort when in use.

specialAccessories.name: Tactical Rails
specialAccessories.description: Tactical rails developed for the Serdyukov pistol, allowing one to change accessories to suit different environments.

specialAccessories.name: Tactical Folding Stock
specialAccessories.description: This folding stock was specially designed for Spectre M4, making the firearm feel and control better.

specialAccessories.name: Wooden Grips
specialAccessories.description: Wooden grips designed for the NZ75. They greatly improve grip sensation.

specialAccessories.name: Osprey 45 Silencer
specialAccessories.description: A silencer in widespread service with the SHD. Mainly used on .45 Vectors. Its excellent performance and rugged appearance have won it much acclaim.

specialAccessories.name: ACOG (4X)
specialAccessories.description: An optical sight that has been modified to the SHD's requirements. When fitted to a rifle, it improves effectiveness in middle to long range combat.

specialAccessories.name: PT-3 Stock
specialAccessories.description: A buttstock designed by the famous Zenitco. Both its design and manufacturing ooze a Russian flavor.

specialAccessories.name: SPP
specialAccessories.description: This 3x variable power scope was originally designed for the NSV-12.7, but after some tweaking, it became a specialized scope for OTs-44.

specialAccessories.name: Triangular Bayonet
specialAccessories.description: A special bayonet that was very popular in past wars. After being modified by IOP, it now boasts greater lethality and penetration.

specialAccessories.name: SCW Buttstock
specialAccessories.description: Not only can the butt of this unique stock be folded up, but the whole thing can also be folded to the side, maximizing the potential of the SCW's ultra-compact design.

specialAccessories.name: SB 2.5-10x56
specialAccessories.description: A high-powered scope manufactured by Schmidt & Bender. WA2000's most frequently-used and favorite optical scope.

specialAccessories.name: Experimental Curved Barrel
specialAccessories.description: Allegedly an experimental product from a bygone war, its blueprint was unearthed and reinvented by I.O.P. Despite its questionable stability and practicality, there has always been a market for the concept of shooting from behind cover.

specialAccessories.name: Special Steel Buttstock
specialAccessories.description: An old buttstock made of steel. Sturdy and durable, the scuff marks on its surface are the scars from the countless battles it has fought.

specialAccessories.name: Exclusive Optical Sight
specialAccessories.description: A 1.6x optical sight developed exclusively for FF F2000. Can be used in low-light environment. It isn't the most practical, but due to its appearance, it has nevertheless become one of FF F2000's favorites.

specialAccessories.name: Exclusive Tactical Flashlight
specialAccessories.description: A tactical flashlight developed exclusively for PP-2000. It can be installed beneath the foregrip. A simple and reliable design.

specialAccessories.name: ZEVT Trigger Unit
specialAccessories.description: A trigger unit developed for the Glock series by ZEVT. The feel of the trigger has been drastically improved with new adjustments.

specialAccessories.name: RBL Grip
specialAccessories.description: A polymer grip developed for the compact Jericho RBL. The reduced weight makes the gun even handier. Only compatible with the RBL model.

specialAccessories.name: Hydraulic Recoil Mitigation System
specialAccessories.description: A hydraulic recoil mitigation system designed specially for the A1-R2 variant. A favorite of TAC-50 that reduces a considerable amount of free recoil generated by the .50BMG chambering.

specialAccessories.name: SR3 Special Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: A brand new suppressor design based on SR-3MP's original one. The length has been shortened to facilitate better performance in short-range firing without compromising its muzzling effectiveness.

specialAccessories.name: Demonic Bell
specialAccessories.description: A present from Minos' father that's meant to be rung when Minos is losing against an enemy, but since that has never happened before, no one knows what the bell actually sounds like.

specialAccessories.name: Grimoire Vol. II
specialAccessories.description: Yurine's secret weapon. It contains spells that serve all sorts of purposes, but it's missing the only one that matters.

specialAccessories.name: EKP-8-18
specialAccessories.description: A Kobra red dot sight which has become DP28's personal equipment after special adjustment.

specialAccessories.name: Custom T1 Red Dot Sight
specialAccessories.description: A T1 Red Dot Sight specially designed for Ribeyrolles by IOP. This accessory can only be used by directly welding a rail to the action. It greatly improves her aiming efficiency.

specialAccessories.name: PK Exclusive Tripod
specialAccessories.description: A tripod specially prepared for the PK machine gun. It was a very widely-used accessory in the past that offers more stability than ordinary bipods.

specialAccessories.name: Synthetic Pistol Grip
specialAccessories.description: A bullpup pistol grip designed for M37. Suitable for rapid firing from the hip, the best way to drown the enemy in lead!

specialAccessories.name: ImpulsIIA/C
specialAccessories.description: A 9mm suppressor designed specially for Px4 Storm. The shortened length of the compact version makes it more suited to combat in small, enclosed spaces. A personal favorite of Px4 Storm's.

specialAccessories.name: Kurtz-Conversion Short Barrel
specialAccessories.description: A short barrel originally designed for the P38K, but with some modifications from IOP, it can now be mounted on P38. Compared to the original long version, the shorter barrel makes it more nimble and easier to conceal.

specialAccessories.name: ILWLP
specialAccessories.description: A rail-grabber mounting tactical system designed specially for Gr Mk23. It is jam-packed full of features, including co-aligned visual and infrared aiming laser, an IR illuminator, and a flashlight.

specialAccessories.name: OMEGA Rail
specialAccessories.description: A full-sized rail for the CZ75B model. Coupled with the OMEGA trigger mechanism, the weapon can now be fired with improved speed and fluidity.

specialAccessories.name: ISM-V
specialAccessories.description: A compound aiming device tailor-made for the XM8 system. Its internal red dot sight and laser system improve aiming precision. One of XM8's favorite accessories.

specialAccessories.name: AN-94 Modernization Kit
specialAccessories.description: A silencer and Picatinny rail kit specially designed for the AN-94 by a famous gunsmith of the past. It gives AN-94 the ability to equip more comprehensive accessories.

specialAccessories.name: M13 Receiver
specialAccessories.description: A new receiver developed to compensate for the weakness of the P7's original receiver. Special features include a widened grip that accommodates the double-stacked magazine and a new magazine release on the side, as well as a larger trigger guard and heat shield.

specialAccessories.name: DHG Extended Handguard
specialAccessories.description: Made by Haga Defense for the P90 with an M-LOK system. Greatly improves the P90's ability to use custom accessories.

specialAccessories.name: P22 Laser Pointer
specialAccessories.description: A compact laser pointer specially designed for P22. After optimization by IOP, its aiming data can be reflected in P22's processing systems in real time.

specialAccessories.name: M5 Bayonet
specialAccessories.description: A bayonet specially prepared for Garand. Its distinguishing feature is that it lacks the usual mounting ring most bayonets have for securing on the barrel, so it looks less like a bayonet than a fighting knife.

specialAccessories.name: 64 Shiki Sniper Scope
specialAccessories.description: A 2.2x optical scope specially designed for the 64 Shiki. Though it's essentially a retired M84 sniper scope, it's been 64 Shiki's trusty companion for years.

specialAccessories.name: Barrett QDL
specialAccessories.description: A quickly-detachable suppressor specially designed for the M82A1. Despite its astounding size, it can be quickly attached or detached depending on mission requirements.

specialAccessories.name: KWS Stock
specialAccessories.description: A modernized product modified from the stock in the KWS upgrade plan. The height is adjustable depending on the situation.

specialAccessories.name: Harris Bipod
specialAccessories.description: The classic bipod by Harris that can be attached to the OBR's pic rail with LaRue's mount. A simple and reliable construction.

specialAccessories.name: CS Red Dot Sight
specialAccessories.description: A classic AimPoint red dot sight with IOP's custom modifications made for Ak 5.

specialAccessories.name: GLX160
specialAccessories.description: A grenade launcher specially designed for the ARX-160 which can be used as a stand-alone weapon or mounted underneath the rifle.

specialAccessories.name: MG42 Exclusive Bipod
specialAccessories.description: A classic and essential bipod for MG42 with improved sturdiness thanks to IOP's modifications.

specialAccessories.name: Luger Snail Drum
specialAccessories.description: One of P08's classic accessories. The 32-round capacity of the drum magazine greatly improves the T-Doll's endurance in battle.

specialAccessories.name: Recoil Reduction Kit
specialAccessories.description: A special recoil reduction system that PT developed specially for the Saiga-12. According to user feedback, it can reduce 40-50% of recoil.

specialAccessories.name: ACR Fixed Stock
specialAccessories.description: A fixed stock for ACR's exclusive use. It is not foldable, but it is more reliable and can be switched out depending on the mission requirement.

specialAccessories.name: M-LOK Handguard
specialAccessories.description: A lightweight M-LOK handguard designed by Clawgear for the AUG that improves the AUG's ability to use accessories.

specialAccessories.name: CBX 12x56 Scope
specialAccessories.description: A Kahles Helia CBX 3-12x56 scope for QBU-88's exclusive use. Compared to the original version, this scope has much higher reliability.

specialAccessories.name: ZF4
specialAccessories.description: A scope that IOP produced exclusively for G43, following schematics from the past. It increases G43's combat efficiency significantly.

specialAccessories.name: BA6 Laser Pointer
specialAccessories.description: A laser pointer designed and produced exclusively for P99 by renowned optical instrument manufacturer STN. Its reliability is further improved with IOP's calibrations.

specialAccessories.name: EVO 3 Handguard
specialAccessories.description: An M-LOK handguard that MI designed for EVO 3's exclusive use. It significantly improves EVO 3's attachment capacity.

specialAccessories.name: GRUNT Rail
specialAccessories.description: Part of K2 modernization kit, effectively increases mounting capacity.

specialAccessories.name: FP6 Folding Stock
specialAccessories.description: A common accessory exclusive to FP-6, allows ease of operation in confined spaces after folding.

specialAccessories.name: PT-2 Telescopic Stock
specialAccessories.description: PKP's favorite telescopic stock produced by Zenitco. An accessory that both looks good and works well.

specialAccessories.name: MHS-33
specialAccessories.description: An M-LOK handguard developed specially for modernising the Gr HK33. It drastically improves the weapon's feel in the hands and attachment capacity.

specialAccessories.name: Dreibein 34
specialAccessories.description: A tripod that IOP refurbished specially for MG34. It enables the weapon to provide fire support with more stability in battle.

specialAccessories.name: Loudspeaker
specialAccessories.description: A common but incredibly robust loudspeaker. It no longer remembers how many busking sessions, fights, and emotional breakdown it has been through with Sakura Minamoto... Perhaps it will still be staying with her for a long, long time.

specialAccessories.name: Beginner's Shamisen
specialAccessories.description: The instrument that Yugiri used when she first started learning the shamisen. Her playing is now subtle and smooth, but she has never forgotten her days as a beginner.

specialAccessories.name: SBAL-PL
specialAccessories.description: Five-seven's preferred compact pistol light, which offers a visible green laser and a 500-lumen white light LED. It is an exceptional product in terms of both performance and appearance, which has a distinctly futuristic feel.

specialAccessories.name: Custom Nylon Grip
specialAccessories.description: A nylon grip designed specially for Bren Ten that greatly improves its hand feel.

specialAccessories.name: Custom Skeleton Stock
specialAccessories.description: A skeleton stock designed specially for M1A1 featuring an improved folding mechanism compared to other common folding stocks.

specialAccessories.name: PT Sight
specialAccessories.description: The new upgrade made to the classic design makes it easier for M1911 to quickly aim at her targets even in low light conditions.

specialAccessories.name: Custom PR Rail
specialAccessories.description: The use of composite materials in this classic design reduces the weight of the rail and, at the same time, improves its precision.

specialAccessories.name: Red Spectacles
specialAccessories.description: Upon further observation, her prosthetic apparently does not require any vision correction, but for whatever reason, she keeps this pair of spectacles on her person at all times.

specialAccessories.name: Polymer Drum Magazine
specialAccessories.description: One of USAS-12's most highly used accessories. The 20-round capacity and the high firing speed give her combat capability a significant boost.

specialAccessories.name: Police Cap of the Night
specialAccessories.description: A cap that Welrod MkII wears when she is on duty. In the face of crime and evil, this cap is a banner of divine justice!

specialAccessories.name: 1PN64 Night Scope
specialAccessories.description: A lightweight and improved product based on the NSP3 low-light scope. The use of the latest image intensifier tube has greatly improved imaging quality.

specialAccessories.name: SSG Goggles
specialAccessories.description: SSG 3000's most frequently worn goggles. They help her lock on to prey quickly.

specialAccessories.name: IDW Buttstock
specialAccessories.description: This buttstock designed specifically for IDW effectively enhances her firing precision.

specialAccessories.name: Bunny Dangle
specialAccessories.description: A dangle that M99 likes to hang on her gun barrel. According to her, it helps with her aim.

specialAccessories.name: Dream Butterfly Pouch
specialAccessories.description: A pouch that ZB-26 often carries with her. It cheers her up even when she is busy with work.

specialAccessories.name: General Liu's Saber
specialAccessories.description: A military saber that General Liu spent a fortune on commissioning. The craftsmanship is exquisite, but it seems to be much more expensive than the market price.

specialAccessories.name: Matryoshka Dangle
specialAccessories.description: A cherished gift from a teammate who wished Fedorov could leave her fears behind.

specialAccessories.name: TS Custom Compensator
specialAccessories.description: A muzzle compensator custom-designed for Thompson. It has multiple vents on its upper side which considerably decrease muzzle climb when firing.

specialAccessories.name: Tactical Glasses
specialAccessories.description: Although she doesn't need visual correction, she asked IOP to make these glasses for her in the hope that she won't scare others away.

specialAccessories.name: Custom Pan Magazine
specialAccessories.description: Below its thick, pan-shaped exterior lies a practicality that isn't often seen in large-capacity magazines. After removing the flashy but useless elements of its design, what remains has been improved to be lighter and more reliable.

specialAccessories.name: Police Hat
specialAccessories.description: Super Shorty always wears this hat when she's on duty, probably so she stands out more in a crowd.

specialAccessories.name: BC Suppressor
specialAccessories.description: A compensator specially designed for DSR-50. It greatly reduces noise produced while firing.

specialAccessories.name: Red Star Dangle
specialAccessories.description: A pendant that symbolizes glory and trust, it spurs RMB-93 to follow the rules ever more diligently.

specialAccessories.name: Orb of Destiny
specialAccessories.description: K5 always carries this crystal ball with her. It can forecast weal or woe for many situations and is widely acclaimed by the Dolls.

specialAccessories.name: Exquisite Dangle
specialAccessories.description: A decoration that's said to be able to attract squirrels. Any human would love an item like this.

specialAccessories.name: Mountaineering Hat
specialAccessories.description: A mountaineering hat that was bespoke tailored for F1. After putting it on, people will regard you as an adventurer.

specialAccessories.name: M91 Telescopic Sight
specialAccessories.description: An upgraded weapon sight that helps its user discern and differentiate distant targets, making it very suitable for precision marksmanship assignments.

specialAccessories.name: PMII Scope
specialAccessories.description: A Gr G28-exclusive rifle scope that's equipped with a standalone lateral parallax adjustment knob, which greatly cuts down on visual displacement. Its optical performance is also extremely good.

specialAccessories.name: VM Goggles
specialAccessories.description: The goggles M82 has always worn. She uses them to immediately hide her eyes if she suddenly meets the gaze of a stranger.

specialAccessories.name: Exclusive Light Intensification Goggles
specialAccessories.description: Light intensification goggles specially designed for KSG. They improve optical contrast and are very useful during outdoors missions.

specialAccessories.name: PKS-07 Scope
specialAccessories.description: This scope features an expanded field of vision over the original and an impressive improvement to precision.

specialAccessories.name: StG Scope
specialAccessories.description: Specially designed for StG44, this scope features excellent optical performance and impressive mechanical stability.

specialAccessories.name: 8×42 Scope
specialAccessories.description: A rifle scope with outstanding performance and versatility. Its excellent light transmission ability allows her to see even the most distant targets clearly and helps with precision shooting.

specialAccessories.name: PK-A Red Dot Sight
specialAccessories.description: Brand-new CQB sights designed for compatibility with Picatinny sights. Its user will be able to find their target even in the darkest night.

specialAccessories.name: PC Communications Earpiece
specialAccessories.description: It uses the latest design that's popular around the world to automatically amplify ambient noise, further improving audio clarity.

camouflageCloak.name: Ragged Cape
camouflageCloak.description: A ragged cape that has been passed down for ages. Having an undisturbed firing environment allows for increased critical damage. Can only be equipped by RFs.

camouflageCloak.name: Camouflage Cape
camouflageCloak.description: A camouflage cape that has been passed down for ages, its mottled edges tell a tale of the flames of war. Having an undisturbed firing environment allows for increased critical damage. Can only be equipped by RFs.

camouflageCloak.name: Urban Camouflage Cape
camouflageCloak.description: A digital camouflage cape developed from Sangvis Ferris technology. It is able to blend into most environments. Having an undisturbed firing environment allows for increased critical damage. Can only be equipped by RFs.

camouflageCloak.name: Thermoptic Camouflage Cape
camouflageCloak.description: A thermoptic camouflage cape developed with military technology, it can adapt its camouflage patterns to the surrounding environment when lying still, allowing sharpshooters to massively increase their critical damage. Can only be equipped by RFs.

camouflageCloak.name: 16Lab Thermoptic Cape
camouflageCloak.description: 16Lab's custom thermoptic camouflage cloak. The secret to 16Lab's high quality cloak is to order 1000 cloaks from IOP, rebrand the best 10 with 16Lab's logo, and then destroying the rest. Can only be equipped by RFs.

auxiliarySight.name: RMR Red Dot Sight
auxiliarySight.description: Made by the famous accessories manufacturer Trijicon, it combines excellent reliability and practicality. Can be used by handguns and machine guns.

auxiliarySight.name: RMR T2 Red Dot Sight
auxiliarySight.description: A red dot sight designed by Trijicon. It incorporates superior electrical pathing logic over the basic RMR to solve power outage issues. Can be used by handguns and machine guns.

auxiliarySight.name: RMR T4 Red Dot Sight
auxiliarySight.description: This RMR red dot sight has been modified for extra compatibility with T-Dolls. A built-in microcomputer provides targeting information to the T-Doll using it. Can be used by handguns and machine guns.

auxiliarySight.name: SBR Custom Handguard
auxiliarySight.description: An SBR lightweight handguard custom-made by 16LAB. It improves the attachment capacity of ST AR-15's secondary weapon.

auxiliarySight.name: Explosive Cyberarm
auxiliarySight.description: This cybernetic arm features a whole new level of destructive power. With Banana's help, it can project a considerable amount of force.

specialApAmmo.name: Mk900 SLAP
specialApAmmo.description: Miniature sabot rounds designed to maximize armor-penetration ability. Can be used by machine guns.

specialApAmmo.name: Mk1000 SLAP
specialApAmmo.description: A brand new kind of sabot round designed by IOP, featuring greatly improved armor-piercing performance. Can be used by machine guns.

chip.name: Experimental Processor
chip.description: A new type of processor developed by IOP that provides a small increase to a Doll's fighting power. Can be used by submachine guns and assault rifles.

chip.name: #1 Processor
chip.description: An improved processor by IOP. Provides a distinct improvement to Doll fighting capabilities when compared to the experimental model. Can be used by submachine guns and assault rifles.

chip.name: #2 Processor
chip.description: IOP's latest second-generation processor. It boasts improved Doll compatibility over the previous generation. Can be used by submachine guns and assault rifles.

chip.name: Focus Chip
chip.description: A new general chip that can effectively enhance a T-Doll's focus while shooting. It can be equipped on Submachine Guns and Assault Rifles.

choke.name: Mk3 Choke
choke.description: A general choke for Shotguns that can shape the spread of the shot to improve its impact in a small area. It can be equipped on Shotguns.

choke.name: Mk4 Choke
choke.description: A general choke for Shotguns modified from the Mk3. Made with brand-new materials, its performance is much more reliable. It can be equipped on Shotguns.

choke.name: Mk0 Multi-Purpose Choke
choke.description: A state-of-the-art choke for Shotguns. Made with revolutionary and specialized materials, the constriction can even be adjusted, making it very reliable. It can be equipped on Shotguns.

rangefinder.name: M1050 LRF
rangefinder.description: A man-portable laser rangefinder and telescope that provides T-Dolls with more information when conducting long-range reconnaissance or making long-range shots. It can be equipped on certain Rifles.

rangefinder.name: M200X LRF
rangefinder.description: A laser rangefinder and telescope for T-Dolls that IOP developed by improving the M1050. Installed with a data synchronization module, it greatly enhances an echelon's teamwork. It can be equipped on certain Rifles.

tripod.name: HD-50 Bipod
tripod.description: A set of general bipod developed by Accu-Tac. With IOP's modifications, it makes T-Dolls more efficient in combat. It can be equipped on Machine Guns.

tripod.name: HD-50 Bipod Mk2
tripod.description: A bipod modified from the standard HD-50. With an upgraded internal electronic control chip for T-Doll use, it further improves T-Dolls' combat efficiency. It can be equipped on Machine Guns.

tripod.name: HD-100 Bipod
tripod.description: Modified from the HD-50 Mk2, this bipod is produced using brand-new materials, which translates to lighter weight and more reliable performance. The internal circuitry has also been further refined, greatly improving T-Dolls' combat efficiency. It can be equipped on Machine Guns.
